publicmods.mark.folder: Ask the server admin for this mod
publicmods.no_mods: This world runs no mods beyond the game's own. Join with the game version above.
publicmods.none: No game is running now, so there are no mods to download. Come back when the server is up.
publicmods.settings.done.off: Turned the public mods page off.
publicmods.settings.done.on: Turned the public mods page on.
publicmods.settings.proxy: If a proxy signs people in before Foreman, it must let paths that start with {path} through without sign-in, or players are asked to sign in. {guide} gives the rule.
publicmods.settings.shares.heading: What turning it on shares
publicmods.settings.shares.mods: Its enabled mods, their versions and their zip files, including mods the mod portal no longer has. Whether the mods may be shared is your call.
publicmods.settings.shares.nothing: Nothing else: no save, setting, password, player or log.
publicmods.settings.shares.world: The running world's name and game version.
publicmods.settings.state.off: The public mods page is off, and its address answers "not found".
publicmods.settings.state.on: The public mods page is on. Anyone who can reach it can download the running world's mods without signing in.
publicmods.settings.title: Public mods page
publicmods.settings.turn_off: Turn off the public mods page
publicmods.settings.turn_on: Turn on the public mods page
publicmods.title: Mods for this server
publicmods.unchecked: The mod portal could not be checked just now, so no mod is marked as missing from it. The downloads work anyway.
publicmods.where.heading: Where the mods go
publicmods.where.step_download: Choose Download all. You get one zip file that holds each mod's own zip file.
publicmods.where.step_keep: Leave each mod's own zip file packed; Factorio reads it as it is.
publicmods.where.step_unpack: Unpack that one file into your Factorio client's mods folder:
